welcome.title.description: The title of the welcome step, the page a new account sees once after signing up, before the home timeline: it asks for a display name and an avatar, both optional. name is the server's name (Example Social). Also the title of the browser tab.

welcome.lead.defaultMessage: 添加显示名称和头像，让大家认出你。
welcome.lead.description: The first line under the title of the welcome step of a new account: what the step is for. The display name and the avatar are the two fields under it (settings.profile.name, settings.profile.avatar).

welcome.later.defaultMessage: 两项都是可选的，之后可以在设置的“个人资料”中更改。
welcome.later.description: The second line under the title of the welcome step of a new account: neither the display name nor the avatar has to be given, and where they are changed later. The quoted word is the entry of the settings (settings.entry.profile).

welcome.continue.description: The primary button of the welcome step of a new account: it saves the display name and the avatar the reader gave, if any, and goes on to the home timeline.

welcome.skip.description: The quiet button under Continue on the welcome step of a new account: it goes on to the home timeline and saves nothing. The reader can set the display name and the avatar later in the settings.

welcome.loading.description: On the page of the welcome step while the reader's account is being read from the server, before the step or the home timeline shows.

welcome.save.failed.defaultMessage: 无法保存你的显示名称和头像。请重试，或暂时跳过。
welcome.save.failed.description: Before the Continue button of the welcome step when saving failed and the server gave no reason (no connection). Skip for now is the button under Continue (welcome.skip).

welcome.save.refused.defaultMessage: 没有保存任何内容。请修正标出的问题，或暂时跳过。
welcome.save.refused.description: Before the Continue button of the welcome step when the server refused the display name or the avatar: what is wrong stands under that field, and this says only that neither was saved and the two ways on. Skip for now is the button under Continue (welcome.skip).

welcome.picture.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, processing {服务器无法处理这张图片。请更换图片，或移除后继续。} other {无法上传这张图片。请重试、更换图片，或移除后继续。}}
welcome.picture.failed.description: Under the avatar on the welcome step when saving failed because of the image and the server gave no words of its own. reason is processing when the server took the file and then could not turn it into a picture it can show, anything else when the upload did not get through. Replace and Remove are the buttons beside the avatar (settings.profile.picture.replace, settings.profile.picture.remove).

welcome.picture.refused.description: Under the avatar on the welcome step when the server refused the image and said why. said is the server's own sentences, in the reader's language, which say what is wrong with the file and what to choose instead (The file is too large. Choose a smaller file.); this adds the other way on. Remove is the button beside the avatar (settings.profile.picture.remove).
